airport.name: General José María Yáñez International Airport

summary: General José María Yáñez International Airport (GYM) is a small international airport serving Guaymas and the nearby resort town of San Carlos on the Sea of Cortez in Sonora, Mexico. It sits about 6 km northwest of downtown Guaymas and roughly 11 km east of San Carlos, with a single runway and a compact terminal. Named after General José María Yáñez, a 19th-century Sonoran military and political figure, it handles limited scheduled domestic flights, charters, and general aviation.
faqs:
Q: What airlines fly to GYM?
A: Scheduled service is limited and can change seasonally; domestic carriers and charter operators may serve the airport, so check current schedules with airlines or booking sites before planning.

Q: How far is the airport from Guaymas and San Carlos?
A: It is about 6 km northwest of downtown Guaymas and roughly 11 km east of San Carlos, typically a 10–15 minute drive to Guaymas and 15–20 minutes to San Carlos.

Q: What facilities are available at the airport?
A: The small terminal offers basic services such as restrooms, a waiting area, taxi access, and sometimes car rental desks; food and retail options are very limited, so plan accordingly.

Q: Is there public transportation from the airport?
A: Regular city bus service is not reliably available at the terminal; taxis, prearranged shuttles, and rental cars are the usual ways to reach Guaymas, San Carlos, and nearby areas.
transport_tips: Taxis and prearranged hotel shuttles are the most reliable options; agree on the fare before leaving or confirm it with your hotel. Rental cars can be booked in advance, but verify desk hours if you arrive on a late or weekend flight. Allow extra time during holiday periods, when taxis and shuttles may be busier.
local_tip: If you're flying in from the north, try to sit on the left side of the aircraft for views of the Sea of Cortez and the San Carlos coastline as you approach.
